factory.name: Card.create | Surface.apply
factory.signature: Card.create(host: HTMLElement, options?: CardOptions): Card; Surface.apply(el: HTMLElement, options?: SurfaceOptions): SurfaceHandle

options.name: title
options.description: Card heading and the <article>'s accessible name (aria-labelledby). Without a title the card is a <div>.

options.name: subtitle
options.description: Supporting line under the title (text only).

options.name: content
options.description: Body content; strings render as text. Omit to fill card.body directly.

options.name: footer
options.description: Footer content such as actions or metadata.

options.name: media
options.description: Image or illustration, shown above the header while the header stays first in source order.

options.name: interactive
options.description: Block-link mode: the title becomes the only link and its ::after covers the card. Requires title; href must be http(s) or relative.

options.name: headingLevel
options.description: Heading level of the card title; match it to the surrounding outline.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Card: consumer host; its children are replaced by the card.

properties.name: element
properties.description: Card: root <article> (titled) or <div>. Replaced when the title is added or removed.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and apply options. Content areas are replaced only when their option is passed; pass undefined to remove title, subtitle, or interactive.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Card: remove the card element and the configuration subscription. SurfaceHandle: remove the classes it added.

cssClasses.name: aui-surface
cssClasses.description: Bordered panel on color-surface with radius-md.

cssClasses.name: aui-card--interactive
cssClasses.description: Block-link card: hover and focus-visible states on the card.

cssClasses.name: aui-card__link
cssClasses.description: Interactive title link; its ::after covers the card.
